# Step - to_tree

`to_tree` · category: [Running and showing results](../../traversal/step_reference.md#running-and-showing-results)

Runs the traversal and renders its results as an indented tree.

## Forms

```text
to_tree()
to_tree(arg1: any)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).out().to_tree()
```
